content: Premium Content Blocks Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000082844 Brilliant Directories’ Web Page Builder has tools just like Microsoft Word, and included are 10+ basic content Pre-made Elements (text with images, videos, buttons, forms, etc.) that can be applied by dragging and dropping into the builder to quickly compose a web page. Now there are premium elements available with even more creative and modern designs available with the Premium Content Blocks. This add-on offers not just blocks of elements, but also fully designed content areas ready to be customized. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP A.-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Premium Content Blocks Add-on Enabling the Add-On This add-on will be available to use under the Content >> Edit Web Pages section : Click " Edit " for an existing page OR click New Web Page + button to create a new web page: Once on the web page, look for the "Pre-Made Elements" section on the right sidebar: The Premium Blocks will display below the default Pre-Made Elements, scroll down to find them. There are more than 25 flexible & modern content layouts which are classfied under: Call to Action – 8 blocks Features List – 8 blocks Team Members List – 5 blocks Standard Content – 9 blocks To start using one of the blocks simply drag-and-drop the block into the static page: Easily customize and edit the elements by using the FROALA Editor options: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
